## Advisor angle
When a sharp tech selloff arrives with talk of a Fed hike, clients who are heavily concentrated in AI and tech stocks may call in worried. An advisor would review how concentrated their portfolios are and remind them of their long-term plan. The headlines suggest investors moved toward Treasuries, so the conversation could also cover diversification.

## Term of the day: Concentration risk
This is the risk of having too much money in one stock, sector, or theme. If that area falls, the whole portfolio falls with it.

## Interview talking point
"Today's AI-led selloff shows why diversification matters: when one theme drives the market, concentrated portfolios take the biggest hit."
